context: Tests whether the solution correctly uses specify-cli's manifest validation API to accept valid extension.yml files and reject invalid ones with descriptive errors. The rubric rewards correct use of validate_manifest and is_manifest_valid, proper detection of missing required fields, unsupported schema versions, and CLI version incompatibility.

checklist.name: Valid manifest passes
checklist.description: Calls validate_manifest (or is_manifest_valid) on a well-formed extension.yml with all required fields and a compatible cli_version, and confirms no error is raised.

checklist.name: Missing required field
checklist.description: Detects and reports a ManifestValidationError that names the missing field when a required field (name, version, or description) is absent from the manifest.

checklist.name: Unsupported schema version
checklist.description: Detects and reports a ManifestValidationError when schema_version is set to an unrecognised value.

checklist.name: CLI version incompatibility
checklist.description: Detects and reports a ManifestValidationError indicating version incompatibility when the manifest's cli_version constraint excludes the installed specify-cli version.
